mathematical_meanings: Left image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right tip of the horizontal axis beside the V-shaped graph). Right image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right arrow on the axis passing through A and B).
Rationales: In both images, x names the horizontal coordinate axis. The relevant locations are the right tip of the horizontal axis beside the V-shaped graph on the left and the right arrow on the axis passing through A and B on the right.
